lines.text: She called me out for being late.

data.define: To say publicly that someone did something wrong.

example.text: She called me out for being late.

misuse.text: Don't 'call out' a coworker in front of the boss.

data.l1_hook: Она всем рассказала о моей ошибке! «call out».
data.l1_ex: Она сделала мне замечание («called me out») за то, что я опоздал.

native.tip: “call out” = выставить на свет; уличить. Пример: “She called me out for being late.”
